notes.title: CLUB LEATHER v2.03.07
notes.content:
Bussy Master: CLUB LEATHER v2.03.07 is live now!

🌟 New Features & Big Updates:

Loading System Upgrade – The Loading system has been upgraded! Loading performance has been improved to reduce PC hanging and slightly improve speed. A potential memory leak has also been fixed.
Video Settings Overhaul – The entire video settings system has been removed and rewritten. All settings are reset to default, and saving now works per device without syncing via Steam Cloud. A new “Monitor” setting has been added, and “Display Mode” options have been updated for improved compatibility and clarity.
Audio Backend Overhaul – The entire audio system has been removed and rewritten for improved performance, features and stability.
New Shuffle & Repeat Switches – The music player now includes shuffle and repeat functionality.
New On-Screen Keyboard – There is now a button next to input boxes that allows you to bring up the OSK.
New Music Track Notifications – A notification now appears when a new music track begins. This notification is draggable and closeable.
New Series VFX – The series name on the main menu now features new visual effects.


🔧 Improvements:

Fixed Time & Date Display – Sizing, positioning, color, and font for the on-screen time and date have been corrected.
Profile Section Updates – Profile section sizing has been refined for better consistency, and section titles are now centered.
Steam Achievement Notification Upgrade – Steam achievement notification is now draggable and includes a close button.
Upgraded Particle VFX – All particle effects have been updated with enhanced visuals.
Updated Icons – Icons in the puzzle settings have been updated for clarity and consistency.
Fixed Social Buttons – All social buttons now function correctly from the main menu.


🔄 Changes:

Default Puzzle Change – The default puzzle has been changed to the Swapping Puzzle to help new players understand the mechanics more easily.
Audio Defaults Changed – Due to backend changes, Master and Music volumes now both default to 100 when reset, rather than 100/75 it used to be.
Removed ‘Not So Secret’ Button – Temporarily removed. It’ll be back in a future update.
Build Version Format Updated – The build version number format has been revised, again.


🐛 Bug Fixes:

Fixed Puzzle Selection – Several game breaking issues with puzzle selection during puzzle play have been resolved.
Framerate Cap Fix – The framerate cap now correctly defaults to 60fps.
Fixed Default Puzzle Selection – The default puzzle selection now correctly defaults to the intended puzzle.


Cheers,
Kink Master Studios

🔙 Beta Branch – As always, whenever a new update is released, the previous version moves to the Beta branch. If you encounter any issues with the latest build, you can easily switch back to the previous version.

notes.title: CLUB LEATHER v2.02.1.06
notes.content:
CLUB LEATHER v2.02.1.06, The BIG Achievement Update, is available now!

🌟 New Features:

Steam Integration & Achievements - With Steam now integrated, there are 48 Achievements to unlock! (If you have already completed the game, or made progress, you will be able to unlock those achievements when you enter the game! However, timed achievements will only start from this update [Please do not quit before 1 minute has accumulated on the "Cum Clock" or your Steam achievements will be reset])
New Achievements Section - Head to the Achievements section on the main menu to unlock your Achievements! The "Cum Clock" will track your time towards the timed achievements!
Settings Available Everywhere - The settings button has been moved to the top left and can now be accessed at anytime. 
Time & Date - New time and date options are now available through the accessibilities, this will allow you to show the time and/or date on the screen. 


🔧 Improvements:

How To Play - New section that explains how to play each puzzle, especially a better explanation on how the Combo (Swapping & Rotating) puzzle works, this can be found via the "?" button. 
Rounded Corners Toggle - New toggle for enabling/disabling the rounded corners of the puzzle pieces, this can be found via the "?" button. 
Default Puzzle - The Default Puzzle dropdown can now also be accessed via the "?" button. 
Disable Keyboard Controls - The keyboard controls for both the Gallery and during gameplay can now be independently turned off via the "?" button. 
Accessibilities & Language Moved  - These have now been moved to the settings and can be accessed at anytime. 
Updated Gallery Layout - The main image is now slightly bigger and better centered while the preview images and the profile are slightly smaller.


🔄 Changes:

New Steam Input - The steam backend has been updated, you can now use any controller supported by Steam Input to play the game!
New Steam Cloud - Your progress is now saved to the Steam cloud! No more losing your progress when uninstalling the game or changing PC's!
Steam Integration - With Steam now fully integrated into this game, this means you will have to open the game through Steam. If you try to open the game without Steam, it will close to open the game through Steam. (You don't need an internet connection, you just need to be logged into Steam to play)
Steam Name - Your Steam name is now shown on the screen, indicating you're logged in correctly. 
Profile Spacing - Adjustments to the profiles spacing were made again with the Gallery changes. 
Button Layout Changes - Due to all the different things that have changed in this update, a lot of buttons have been moved or deleted!


🐛 Bug Fixes:

Loading Screen Text - Issues with certain texts not being shown during the loading screen has been fixed. 
Background Deselect - Clicking the background will now correctly deselect a puzzle piece if one was selected. 


🔮 Teaser:

Not So Mysterious Button - New big feature, coming in a future update! (No ETA)


📢 Announcement:

Bussy Master: CLUB LEATHER Original Soundtrack - Coming to Steam and more! (No ETA)


Cheers,
Kink Master Studios.

🔙 Beta Branch - As always, whenever a new update is released, the previous version moves to the Beta branch. If you encounter any issues with the latest build, you can easily switch back to a version that worked for you.

notes.title: CLUB LEATHER v2.01.1.05
notes.content:
CLUB LEATHER v2.01.1.05 is available now!


New Minimize Button - New minimize button, next to the quit button. 
New Puzzle Controls - You can now control some of the elements on the puzzle scene from the keyboard, such as cycling puzzle types, difficulty and reloading the scene. 
New Puzzle Controls Hints - New button next to the music player button. Contains all the controls for the game and the puzzle scene. 
New Pack and Image Select Text - The pack select screen will now show you how many packs are currently completed while the Image Select text will tell you how many images in that pack you have completed. 
Character Profile Selector - Now only appears when there is more than one character profile to look at (This will make name readability more clear).
Character Profile Spacing - The character profiles have been spaced out to be more even and update correctly on character change (For both the Gallery and Puzzle). 
Music Player with Maximized Image - If you are in the gallery with the image maximized and the music player up, you can now correctly control the music player without having to leave the maximized image. 
Scrolling for Pack & Image Select and Gallery Updated - The gallery preview images as well as main image no longer reset to the first character when entering and exiting the gallery. The pack select horizontal scrolling no longer resets. The image select horizontal scrolling now resets to the start of the images. 
Updated Music Controls - Keyboard controls for the music player have changed to "~" and "1".
Gallery Hints Button - Button has been moved to next to the music player button. 
Puzzle Text Updates - Buttons now say "Previous Puzzle", "Next Puzzle", "Next Puzzle Pack". 


Cheers.
Kink Master Studios.

Beta Branch - Whenever a new update is released, the previous version moves to the Beta branch. If you ever encounter any issues with the latest build, you can easily switch back to a version that worked for you.

notes.title: Bussy Master: CLUB LEATHER v2 AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Attention CLUB LEATHER Lovers - v2 AVAILABLE NOW!

Whether you're a returning player or new to the scene, Bussy Master: CLUB LEATHER has been re-leathered with v2. This isn't just an enhancement; it's a complete rebuild, aligning with the latest Bussy Master series standards.

This free update introduces a brand new game experience, built from the ground up to surpass v1 in every aspect, including:


 New combo puzzle
 Ability to randomize puzzle types
 Enhanced gallery with customization
 New & Improved accessibility options
 Over double the original music tracks of the original game
 Plus much more! (Discover more in-game!)


As this is essentially a new game, starting from the beginning is required if you have played before. However, you can still access v1 through the Betas if you wish to continue from your previous progress.

Cheers.
Kink Master Studios.
